items.title: Rooftop Embers & Basalt Hearth
items.desc: An open-air culinary experience where native wood and dry charcoal flame-grill seasonal harvest under Gachibowli’s night skies. Savor dishes served on raw basalt slate.

items.title: Fermented Elixirs & Botanicals
items.desc: A curated ritual of native tonics, house-made vinegars, and forest honey infusions. Crafted by master mixologists and poured in custom architectural ceramics.

items.title: The Gallery Dining Salon
items.desc: Dine in an environment where modern Indian painting, sculptural architecture, and gastronomy converge. A collaborative experience featuring seasonal art installations.
